observations: runx --version returned runx-cli 0.6.14, satisfying the required minimum.

The package name is exactly contract-drafter and the published registry ref is iwannabefree00/contract-drafter@sha-8f6b4fdaeab7.

The send_proposal is explicitly status gated_not_sent and names downstream_skill send-as; this skill never sends.
